Export a survey dataset's codebook as a DDI Codebook XML file

Source: R/ddi.R
sd_export_ddi.Rd

Builds a DDI Codebook 2.6 codeBook element from an sd_data object's metadata (meta$roles, meta$labels, meta$value_labels, meta$missing_codes) and writes it to an XML file using the DDIwR package. This is metadata-only: unlike DDIwR::convert(), it does not require (or embed) the actual data values, since sd_data's metadata is kept separately from the data (see new_sd_data()).

Usage

sd_export_ddi(x, file = "codebook.xml", title = NULL, overwrite = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

An sd_data object.

file

Path to write the XML file to. Default "codebook.xml".

title

Study title. Defaults to x$meta$paradata$nimi if set, otherwise "Untitled dataset". Passed on to DDIwR::exportCodebook() as titl, which auto-fills the mandatory stdyDscr/docDscr elements when they are not already present in codeBook.

overwrite

If FALSE (the default) and file already exists, sd_export_ddi() refuses to overwrite it.

...

Further arguments passed on to DDIwR::exportCodebook() (e.g. agency, IDNo, abstract, monolang).

Value

Invisibly, the codeBook list object passed to DDIwR::exportCodebook() (before its internal auto-fill of stdyDscr/docDscr — read the exported file back with DDIwR::getCodebook() to inspect the complete, final structure).

Recommended order

Run sd_detect_roles() and sd_set_missing() before sd_export_ddi() — the DDI export uses meta$roles to set each variable's format type, and meta$missing_codes to mark categories as missing="Y" in the codebook (via DDIwR::makeCategories()).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
aineisto <- sd_read("survey_data.sav")
aineisto <- sd_detect_roles(aineisto)
aineisto <- sd_set_missing(aineisto, codes = c(99, -9))
sd_export_ddi(aineisto, file = "codebook.xml", title = "Tyotyytyvaisyyskysely 2026")
} # }
